Filter materials should be adequately compacted into place so as not to form a weaker
zone which could affect the stability of the engineering structure.

Where perforated or slotted drainage pipes are provided within a filter material, the
filter particles should be sufficiently large so as not to enter the perforations, slots or open
joints in the pipes. The ends of the pipes should also be closed to prevent entry of the filter
materials.
